The exact-title lookup was not reliable. I’m querying the University of Leicester publication archive and repository APIs directly for the title and related keywords.
```python
repo_search = await web_fetch("https://api.openalex.org/works?search=%22Can%20Hiccup%20Supply%20Enough%20Fish%22&per-page=10", max_chars=12000)
print(repo_search)
```
I’m checking Crossref’s title-filtered endpoint with a strict bibliographic query, then I’ll inspect any matching record’s full text or links.
```python
strict_lookup = await web_fetch("https://api.crossref.org/works?query.bibliographic=Can%20Hiccup%20Supply%20Enough%20Fish%20to%20Maintain%20a%20Dragon%27s%20Diet&rows=20&select=DOI,title,author,published,URL,link,resource", max_chars=20000)
print(strict_lookup)
```
I’m using the likely journal archive’s search page directly, because this paper may be a student article omitted from Crossref and general search.
```python
journal_search = await web_fetch("https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish%22", max_chars=20000)
print(journal_search)
```
I’m querying an alternate public search endpoint for the exact title and the distinctive phrase “fish bag,” since the primary search backend returned no index results.
```python
alt_endpoint = await web_fetch("https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish+to+Maintain+a+Dragon%27s+Diet%22+%22fish+bag%22", max_chars=20000)
print(alt_endpoint)
```
I’m checking the University of Leicester student journal archive by its known publication name and title fragment.
```python
archive_page = await web_fetch("https://www2.le.ac.uk/departments/physics/research/journal-of-physics-special-topics", max_chars=20000)
print(archive_page)
```
I’m sorry, but I couldn’t verify the paper’s calculated fish-bag volume from the available sources.
